gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-elymai: Almendra Display brings an ornate, bookish flourish, its letters never pinching shut. Noto Sans Elymaic does the quieter job of staying legible, with open apertures and a plain sans manner that lets the heading perform.
gen-audiowide-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans handles the text with rounded letters, each with a clearly open side and no stroke modulation at all. And Audiowide sits above it like spaced tiles, futuristic and wide, so a longer read feels smooth and lightly technical.
gen-flavors-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Schibsted Grotesk has big, open-looking e and a shapes, with terminals that never close in. And Flavors is the whimsical foil, its lines flat like a sign-painter's stencil, which gives the pair its strongest quality: loud and friendly in one go.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-sarpanch: Sarpanch keeps a compact gap between x-height and ascender line, with a lowercase e that stays clearly open. And Autour One, bold and expressive, draws its diagonals just as thick as its uprights, which is the pair's strongest quality: weight against restraint.
gen-eater-gf-sen: Sen draws a line of constant weight around every lowercase letter, curves ending before they turn inward, modern and unfussy. Eater's moderate thick-thin play keeps the page dark and reads bitterly against that plain sans.
gen-flavors-gf-sintony: Chunky and playful, Flavors traces everything as if with one marker tip, its diagonals as heavy as its stems. And Sintony follows with a smooth, tidy read and no clogged curves, which is the pair's strongest quality: bold fun that leaves room to breathe.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-sofia-sans-semi-con: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed reads crisply, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals and each curve given a big visible entrance. And a longer passage would flow in a steady, stencil-cut channel, with Autour One's bold roundness leading it in.
gen-eater-gf-sono: Eater brings dark, aggressive stamp-like marks, its thin and thick strokes only mildly different, while its ascenders stay stubby. Sono answers with wide spacing and a plain sans lowercase whose a is left ajar.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-epilogue: Bold and expressive, Balsamiq Sans lays down a stencil-cut line without a single pinched curve. And Epilogue carries a longer passage on curvy, unclamped letters with stubby ascender tips, a wire-thin skeleton keeping the reading light.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-public-sans: Pen-drawn and bold, Balsamiq Sans keeps a constant line weight with no pinched curves. Public Sans takes over with a hefty lowercase and broad open counters on c and s, so a longer passage reads steadily and trustworthy.
